name: Python Base Dev Container
postCreateCommand: bash -lc 'set -e; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 || (curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh); UV_LINK_MODE=copy "$HOME/.local/bin/uv" python install 3.14; UV_LINK_MODE=copy "$HOME/.local/bin/uv" sync --locked --verbose'
